Name: Resourcive M365 Assessment
Description: Licence-aware checks for Microsoft 365 tenants: Conditional Access What-If scenarios, Intune and Defender endpoint controls, mail persistence and coverage by assignment, identity gaps.

Resourcive.CA.MaxScenarios.Description: Most Conditional Access What If scenarios to run. The cap is applied round-robin by persona, privileged personas first. Raise it to probe more.

Resourcive.CA.MaxPrivilegedUsers.Description: Most privileged users tested individually as their own persona.

Resourcive.CA.IncludeReportOnly.Description: Whether report-only policies are read when working out personas and sign-in conditions. They never count towards a pass.

Resourcive.CA.MaxUsers.Description: Most users read when grouping users into personas.

Resourcive.CA.MaxExplicitApps.Description: Most individually named applications that get scenarios of their own.

Resourcive.CA.MaxLocations.Description: Most countries or named locations used as sign-in locations in scenarios.

Resourcive.CA.PersonaFile.Description: Path of a JSON file that stores the personas, so reruns test the same users. Empty means personas are not saved.

Resourcive.CA.RefreshPersonas.Description: Rebuild the personas from the tenant instead of reading PersonaFile.

Resourcive.CA.DesiredStateFile.Description: Path of a JSON file describing the Conditional Access outcome each persona is expected to get. Empty uses the default expectations.

Resourcive.CA.RedactUserNames.Description: Show the persona label instead of the user principal name in scenario titles and results.
